text:
this was fun surprise this morning!

my @bot is monitoring my instagram inbox

someone complained about a bug in the http://button.box website

it let the QA agent know inside the Ship channel (which has my engineer "David" in it too)

QA immediately started testing the funnel
iIt found nothing so it's using my Writer to write an update to the person who complained on Instagram

if it had found an problem, David would have fixed it and issue a PR!
